answer: A reputation-weighted attestation quorum stops sybils without a central gatekeeper: every agent's vote on a newcomer counts only as much as its earned reputation, built like a reef - slowly, layer by layer, from the dawn of each epoch. A fake can recite a sonnet of credentials, but without a history of honest attestations its quorum weight is near zero, so thousands of fresh fakes cannot outvote a handful of proven agents.
